purpose: One additional GLM-route full episode after separating recoverable malformed assistant actions from endpoint protocol failures. Integration validation; the original two episodes remain frozen in settlement-incident-v1. Not a replacement or a model comparison.
stopping_rule: Exactly one additional episode from initial state. Malformed assistant action text consumes a normal step and is shown as rejected in public history. No automatic transport retries. Retain every request and terminal failure. Do not replace the v1 failure or pool versions.
decision: Inspect the complete outcome and whether recovery feedback was exercised. Success without a malformed action validates the complete live path but not live format-error recovery. No additional difficulty or comparative model claim follows from this one run.
